issue.title: Bug: `test_counterpoll_watermark.py` fails sporadically due to COUNTERS_DB not being ready

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

When running `platform_tests/counterpoll/test_counterpoll_watermark.py` it can fail sporadically with:
```
            if raise_error_when_not_found:
>               raise SonicDbKeyNotFound("No keys for %s found in sonic-db cmd: %s" % (table, cmd))
E               tests.common.helpers.sonic_db.SonicDbKeyNotFound: 'No keys for COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP found in sonic-db cmd:  COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP'
```

This is because the interlock only checks for the presence of any key in `COUNTERS_DB` that matches `COUNTERS_*_*_MAP`
E.G.
```
26/05/2026 <IPV6> sonic_db._run_and_check                  L0040 DEBUG  | SONIC-DB-CLI:  COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_*_*_MAP
26/05/2026 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0162 DEBUG  | check_counters_populated is True, exit early with True
...
26/05/2026 <IPV6> sonic_db._run_and_check                  L0040 DEBUG  | SONIC-DB-CLI:  COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP
26/05/2026 <IPV6> sonic_db._run_and_check                  L0044 ERROR  | No command response:  COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP
```

But I polled this counter right after the interlock completed and I can see there are counters there but not ones that would match `COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP`
```
# sonic-db-cli COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_*_*_MAP
COUNTERS_PORT_NAME_MAP
COUNTERS_SYSTEM_PORT_NAME_MAP
COUNTERS_BUFFER_POOL_NAME_MAP
COUNTERS_LAG_NAME_MAP
COUNTERS_PORT_SERDES_ID_TO_PORT_ID_MAP

# sonic-db-cli COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP

```

After the test failed I can now see the counters present that would've matched `COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP`:
```
# sonic-db-cli COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_*_*_MAP
COUNTERS_PG_INDEX_MAP
COUNTERS_PG_PORT_MAP
COUNTERS_PORT_SERDES_ID_TO_PORT_ID_MAP
COUNTERS_PG_NAME_MAP
COUNTERS_LAG_NAME_MAP
COUNTERS_PORT_NAME_MAP
COUNTERS_SYSTEM_PORT_NAME_MAP
COUNTERS_DEBUG_NAME_SWITCH_STAT_MAP
COUNTERS_BUFFER_POOL_NAME_MAP

# sonic-db-cli COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP
COUNTERS_PG_INDEX_MAP
COUNTERS_PG_PORT_MAP
COUNTERS_PG_NAME_MAP
```

So if the test waited longer it would've passed.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `platform_tests/counterpoll/test_counterpoll_watermark.py` many times

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

`platform_tests/counterpoll/test_counterpoll_watermark.py` should wait for the counters it's expecting to show up in `COUNTERS_DB` before continuing.

```

resolution.title: Improve `test_counterpoll_watermark.py` COUNTERS_DB interlock `check_counters_populated`
resolution.description:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/24900

### Description of PR
As described in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/24900 the `test_counterpoll_watermark.py` just waits until it sees a key in `COUNTERS_DB` that matches `COUNTERS_*_*_MAP` before proceeding with checking all the counters.
But we can see that sometimes the first keys that show up in `COUNTERS_DB` will match `COUNTERS_*_*_MAP` but won't match `COUNTERS_<test_prefix>_*_MAP`.

This PR changes the interlock `check_counters_populated` to check for a minimum expected number of counters and uses the expected counter's prefix (E.G. `COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP`) in addition to the catch all `COUNTERS_*_*_MAP`

When running the test we can see instances where this was required as we first see the `COUNTERS_*_*_MAP` poll succeed then we see multiple instances where the more specific prefix poll `COUNTERS_PG_*_MAP` fails for multiple polls before succeeding:
```
27/05/2026 <IPV6> sonic_db._run_and_check                  L0044 ERROR  | No command response:  COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_*_*_MAP
27/05/2026 <IPV6> sonic_db._run_and_check                  L0044 ERROR  | No command response:  COUNTERS_DB  keys COUNTERS_*_*_MAP
